content: Streaming-input protocol details: required flags are --output-format stream-json --input-format stream-json --verbose. Each JSON message must be a single NDJSON line, newline-terminated and flushed. User message shape: {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":"..."}}. Control requests share the shape {"type":"control_request","request_id":"req_1","request":{"subtype":"initialize"|"interrupt",...}}; CLI answers with {"type":"control_response","response":{"subtype":"success"|"error","request_id":"req_1"}}. Stdout events: system/init (session_id, capabilities), assistant, user, stream_event (with --include-partial-messages), system/api_retry, and a terminal result event carrying session_id, total_cost_usd and token counts. Graceful shutdown = close stdin; SIGTERM if it does not exit. Known gaps: --input-format stream-json is essentially undocumented (claude-code issue 24594); mid-turn stdin is ignored by the in-flight turn and not persisted (issue 41230); there is no plain {type:interrupt} stdin message (issue 41665 closed).
